question: Should maintainers make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94416 the canonical Matrix missing-key recovery fix and supersede https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94044?
rationale: The issue is valid and has overlapping open fixes with different risk profiles; automation should not choose the Matrix retry-state ownership boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Use the focused bridge fix
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94416 if maintainers accept retaining exhausted MatrixEvent retry state until a later crypto key signal or stop cleanup.

options.title: Ask for an API seam first
options.body: Pause the candidate PRs and ask for a maintainer-approved Matrix retry API boundary before changing the bridge behavior.

options.title: Prefer the broader lifecycle fix
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94044 canonical only if maintainers intentionally accept broader sync-error recovery and its auth/session risk.

recommendation.title: Use the focused bridge fix
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94416 if maintainers accept retaining exhausted MatrixEvent retry state until a later crypto key signal or stop cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest feature-history signal for the Matrix decrypt bridge and sync lifecycle surfaces involved.
